title: RAMA Adaptive Safety Validation on rel-avito/ad-ctr (Extreme-Cardinality Stress Test)
summary: Demo notebook for RAMA (Rank-Aware Moment Aggregation) stress test on rel-avito/ad-ctr extreme-cardinality regression task. Implements standalone RAMA aggregation with dual PyTorch/NumPy backends, tests on synthetic data verifying zero-init gate behavior, loads pre-computed 5-seed experiment results, re-runs statistical analysis (Cohen's d=0.82, MAE diff=33.6%, R2 not catastrophic), analyzes gate values across 14 edge types, and produces 4-panel visualization of MAE, R2, gate-vs-cardinality, and timing/memory overhead.
